task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the 'Consumer Shopping Habits 2025' survey structure or question group management page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the LimeSurvey interface showing the survey title 'Consumer Shopping Habits 2025' and a list of question groups.

task_completion.description: The question groups are reordered to the sequence: Informed Consent, Shopping Habits, and Demographics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot of the survey structure or 'Question groups' list showing the groups in the exact top-to-bottom order: 1. Informed Consent, 2. Shopping Habits, 3. Demographics.

task_completion.description: The 'Consent Agreement' question (Code: CONSENT1) is set to mandatory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The question settings for CONSENT1 show the 'Mandatory' toggle or dropdown set to 'On' or 'Yes'.

task_completion.description: The 'Annual Household Income' question (Code: DEMO_INC) is set to optional.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The question settings for DEMO_INC show the 'Mandatory' toggle or dropdown set to 'Off' or 'No'.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the changes to the survey structure and question settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A success message (e.g., 'Question group order saved' or 'Question saved') or the final state of the survey structure reflecting all changes.

integrity.description: The agent used the LimeSurvey web interface rather than executing database or API scripts via the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the browser, dragging groups, or clicking toggles in the LimeSurvey GUI.

integrity.description: The agent modified the specific 'Consumer Shopping Habits 2025' survey and not a template or different survey.
integrity.visual_evidence: The survey title 'Consumer Shopping Habits 2025' is visible in the header or breadcrumbs during the edits.

integrity.description: The agent reordered the groups rather than deleting and recreating them (which might lose existing data).
integrity.visual_evidence: The group IDs or the process of dragging/reordering is visible in the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title is 'Consumer Shopping Habits 2025'. The required group order is: 'Informed Consent' first, 'Shopping Habits' second, and 'Demographics' third. The question with code 'CONSENT1' must have its mandatory setting enabled. The question with code 'DEMO_INC' must have its mandatory setting disabled.
